user_story: As a user, I want to be able to hover over user avatars to reveal links to their profiles, so that I can view more information about each user. Acceptance Criteria: When I hover over the avatar of user 1, I should see a link with the text 'View profile' that navigates to '/users/1'. Similarly, hovering over user 2's avatar should reveal 'View profile' that navigates to '/users/2', and user 3's avatar should reveal 'View profile' that navigates to '/users/3'.
